{"id":"mimid-1wgh.114","title":"mimid: a stock client cannot start a call; the agent's front ends offer no VTC surface","description":"Step 4 of the build order on decision mimid-1wgh.113. Steps 1 to 3 are
built (bead mimid-1wgh.108): HostOptions::parent, Store::start_call and
Store::media_secret, with the hub enforcing room-policy-04 §5 and running
the cascade of decision mimid-1wgh.111.

WHAT IS MISSING. Only an embedder of mimid-agent-store reaches any of it.
No front end offers a call:

- the JMAP front end (mimid-agent-jmap) has no VTC capability and no
  method that starts a call or hands a client the media secret;
- the IRC front end has nothing either, and a stock IRC client has
  nowhere to put a call;
- Room::parent is in the record but no front end projects it, so a client
  cannot even tell a call room from a chat.

WHY IT MATTERS. mimid ships no UI (decision mimid-1wgh.38) and exists to
serve stock clients. Mark 2026-11-23: "getting the vtc part right will
demo well, and is the feature that normies will demand". Until this bead
a call is reachable only from Rust.

WHAT TO DECIDE FIRST. The surface itself: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc is ours
to write or extend, and the media secret is key material crossing the
agent's loopback boundary to a client, which needs its own decision about
what a client may ask for and over what. That is not a small question and
should not be answered inside this bead without Mark.

DO NOT confuse this with draft-atwood-mimi-calls, which is the MIMI-side
keying and is written. This is the client-facing half.

{"notes":"MARK DECIDED 2026-11-23: both routes. Filed as two children.

THE QUESTION. Everything built for bead mimid-1wgh.108 is reachable only
from Rust. Two different ways to put a call in front of a user:

(a) THE LINK. mimi-content-10 §5.10's `session` disposition, "a
description of a multimedia session, or a URI used to join one". Every
chat client already renders a message with a link. mimid already READS
these: mimid-agent-store content.rs decodes a session part into a Call
record, and the front ends show it (docs/design/agent-frontends.md
§7.24). It cannot SEND one: there is no Session in action.rs or
convert.rs. Reaches everyone, including a user on another provider's
client. What sits behind the URI is a media service, NOT keyed by the
call room's MLS group, so this route does not use today's keying at all.

(b) THE EXTENSION. A VTC capability on the agent's own JMAP endpoint:
start a call, see that there is one, fetch the epoch's media secret. The
client runs the media layer's key schedule over it, which is what
draft-atwood-mimi-calls §4.3 specifies ("uses it as the input keying
material of the media layer's own key schedule ... A client MUST NOT use
the media_secret directly as a media encryption key"). End-to-end
encrypted under the room's own key. Only a client that speaks our
extension gets it, so "stock client" means "stock client plus our
extension", and nobody else implements it.

CHOSEN: both. They are reach versus the feature. (a) is how a call
reaches a user on Haven's hub; (b) is the thing the draft exists to make
true and the thing that demos as "this call is end-to-end encrypted, and
here is why".

NOT A KEY-HANDOFF DECISION, which is what this bead originally reserved:
the draft settles it. §4.3 hands the client `media_secret` as input
keying material, so the agent handing it over its loopback endpoint is
what our own draft specifies, and deriving something else there would be
the agent doing the media layer's job. The boundary is the one that
already carries plaintext (docs/design/frontend-auth.md §3): loopback,
bearer credential."}

than picking from the options offered.

Route (a) above describes "the link": a §5.10 session part carrying the
call room's mimi:// URI. That was MY suggestion and it was wrong. §5.10

  a client that knows it acts on. Joining stays a MIMI operation: the
  invite start_call already sends, and eventually

THE DECISION STANDS AS "BOTH", with the halves correctly named:

- mimid-1wgh.114.1: announce a live call in the parent chat. An ordinary

  mimi-content extensions-map key (§4.3) that names the call room, which

- mimid-1wgh.114.3: §5.10 for what it is actually for, an external
  conference URL somebody supplies. P3, the interoperation half.
ALL THREE STATED GAPS ARE CLOSED, 2026-11-24/25. This bead's title no longer describes mimid: a stock client CAN start a call.

  1. "the JMAP front end has no VTC capability and no method that starts a call or hands a client the media secret" -- shipped, bead mimid-1wgh.114.2, behind [jmap] vtc (off by default, decision mimid-1wgh.119). Negotiation proven end to end by mimid-1wgh.114.10, which found and fixed three independently fatal bugs (.114.11, .114.12, .114.13).
  2. "the IRC front end has nothing either" -- bead mimid-1wgh.114.6: the link kind of call sends (.114.3), a keyed call announced elsewhere is a server NOTICE saying this client cannot join, and the call's own room gets no channel so there is nothing to join by mistake.
  3. "Room::parent is in the record but no front end projects it, so a client cannot even tell a call room from a chat" -- bead mimid-1wgh.114.11 projects a VTCCall from the call room, and the announcement of mimid-1wgh.114.1 carries what the room does not.

Plus, beyond the three: the chat now says a call started (mimid-1wgh.114.1, decision mimid-1wgh.128), so a user whose client cannot join still learns a call happened.

WHAT IS LEFT UNDER THIS BEAD IS NEW WORK, not the gap it describes:

  - mimid-1wgh.114.7, an SFU of mimid's own, so IRC and stream edges have something to call. A new capability, not a missing front-end surface.
  - mimid-1wgh.114.9, a demo client in ParlorVTC's shape. A separate artefact; labelled human.

FOR MARK: this bead can be closed with those two re-parented to mimid-1wgh, or kept open as their parent. I have not done either, because which it should be is a curation choice and the bead is P1, so it heads bd ready either way. Flagged rather than decided.

Also open and found by this work: mimid-1wgh.129 (a restart inside an epoch loses a live call's media secret; Mark decided to roll the epoch, blocked on nothing now that .114.1 exists) and mimid-1wgh.130 (an invite to a call room cannot be told apart from any other invite)."}
